# Loading Data and Packages

```{python}

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the cleaned dataset
full_df = pd.read_csv("data/full_df.csv")

```

# EDA

```{python}

# Basic info

full_df.info()

full_df[["conf_cases", "temp_avg", "temp_max", "temp_min", "precip_total", "humidity_avg"]].describe()


``` 

```{python}

# Cases per year

full_df["weekdate"] = pd.to_datetime(full_df["weekdate"])

plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5))

sns.lineplot(
    data=full_df,
    x="weekdate",
    y="conf_cases"
)

plt.title("Weekly Confirmed Dengue Cases in Puerto Rico (1986–2024)")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Confirmed Dengue Cases")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

```


```{python}

annual_cases = (
    full_df.groupby("year")["conf_cases"]
    .sum()
    .reset_index()
)

plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5))

sns.barplot(
    data=annual_cases,
    x="year",
    y="conf_cases",
    color="steelblue"
)

plt.title("Annual Confirmed Dengue Cases in Puerto Rico")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Total Confirmed Cases")
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()


```


```{python}

# Seasonal trends

weekly_avg = (
    full_df.groupby("week")["conf_cases"]
    .mean()
    .reset_index()
)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))

sns.lineplot(
    data=weekly_avg,
    x="week",
    y="conf_cases"
)

plt.title("Average Weekly Dengue Cases by Week of Year")
plt.xlabel("Week of Year")
plt.ylabel("Average Confirmed Cases")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

```

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(14, 12))

sns.lineplot(
    data=full_df,
    x="weekdate",
    y="temp_avg",
    ax=axes[0]
)
axes[0].set_title("Weekly Average Temperature")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Temperature (°C)")

sns.lineplot(
    data=full_df,
    x="weekdate",
    y="precip_total",
    ax=axes[1]
)
axes[1].set_title("Weekly Total Precipitation")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Precipitation (mm)")

sns.lineplot(
    data=full_df,
    x="weekdate",
    y="humidity_avg",
    ax=axes[2]
)
axes[2].set_title("Weekly Average Relative Humidity")
axes[2].set_ylabel("Relative Humidity (%)")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

```


```{python}
climate_vars = ["temp_avg", "precip_total", "humidity_avg"]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16, 5))

for ax, var in zip(axes, climate_vars):
    sns.scatterplot(
        data=full_df,
        x=var,
        y="conf_cases",
        alpha=0.4,
        ax=ax
    )

    ax.set_title(f"Dengue Cases vs. {var}")
    ax.set_ylabel("Confirmed Dengue Cases")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()



```

```{python}

# Heatmap
cols = [
    "conf_cases",
    "temp_avg",
    "temp_max",
    "temp_min",
    "precip_total",
    "humidity_avg"
]

corr_matrix = full_df[cols].corr()

plt.figure(figsize=(9, 7))

sns.heatmap(
    corr_matrix,
    annot=True,
    cmap="coolwarm",
    center=0,
    fmt=".2f"
)

plt.title("Correlation Between Climate Variables and Dengue Cases")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()


```
